## Projects

### Daily Spark
- **Type**: Productivity App — Offline-First Habit Tracking
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, IndexedDB, Capacitor Android
- **Description**: An offline-first habit and daily streak tracking application with local IndexedDB persistence
  and Capacitor support for Android builds. Designed for distraction-free productivity without internet dependency.
- **Live App**: https://daily-spark-app-da74b.web.app
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/sahaya-savari/daily-spark

### PrepMind AI
- **Type**: AI Education Platform
- **Tech Stack**: Python, LLMs, OpenAI API, React, Tailwind CSS
- **Description**: An intelligent study companion that uses Python-based LLM integration pipelines to generate
  practice questions, summaries, and personalized learning paths from uploaded study materials. Transforms static
  content into adaptive, interactive learning experiences.
- **Status**: In Development

### Portfolio Website
- **Type**: Web Engineering & SPA Architecture
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite 7, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS v4, Static Pre-rendering, Firebase Hosting
- **Description**: A modern portfolio website featuring glassmorphism design, hardware-accelerated animations,
  HLS video streaming, static HTML pre-rendering across 9 routes, and Firebase Hosting CDN deployment.
- **Live Site**: https://sahayasavari.me
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/sahaya-savari/portfolio
